items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline. Chars voices funny cartoon characters, short and punchy.
lines: Every American ruler is secretly metric.
Since eighteen ninety-three, the US has defined its inch and pound using the metre and the kilogram.
Today, one inch is exactly two point five four centimetres. By definition.
[nervous cartoon wooden ruler, whispering] Shh... don't tell anyone I'm metric.
In nineteen seventy-five, Congress passed a metric act... but made it voluntary.
And that got expensive. In nineteen ninety-nine, one team's software gave thrust numbers in US units, while NASA's navigation expected metric.
The Mars Climate Orbiter flew too low... and was lost. A three hundred and twenty-seven million dollar mission.
And until twenty twenty-two, the US even had two different feet. One for surveyors... slightly longer.
[confused cartoon wooden ruler] Wait... which foot am I?
So why hasn't America switched? Habit... and the cost of changing everything, from road signs to recipes.
This is Bhoogol. Follow for more Geography Fun Facts.
